marketAnalysis.summary:
# Korean Market Analysis (October 1, 2026)
**KOSPI Status:** KOSPI closed at 6,971.35 [71136364], down amid broader regional pressure. **Global Context:** US equities (SPX 7,662.56 [26ccb858]) turned mixed despite cooler inflation (CPI 3.4% [2026-08-01]), while the 10Y Treasury yield spiked to 5.327% [4dea7188]—a 24-year high per reporting. **Risk Sentiment:** VIX at 16.62 [7fd194df] suggests contained volatility, though Fear&Greed at 32 [2026-10-01] signals cautious positioning. **Commodity Headwinds:** Gold at $4,192.10/oz [d640f902] and WTI at $91.24/barrel [da9095ca] reflect safe-haven demand and supply recovery.
**One Reading:** Per CNBC reporting, cooler-than-expected inflation data have failed to support equities; instead, the elevated 10Y yield is dominating positioning. If Treasury yields continue climbing (invalidating a pivot to accommodation), Korean exporters and rate-sensitive sectors face renewed headwinds. Verify: Fed forward guidance and domestic Korean rate expectations.
